summary: Applies skeleton or transform-based skin deformation using capture attributes such as bone paths, bind poses, and per-point or per-vertex capture weights. It can deform P and other attributes from capture data or a separate geometry source.

key_params.name: inputattrscope
key_params.note: Input attribute or attribute scope for attribute deformation modes

key_params.name: vlength
key_params.note: Maintain vector lengths for vector attributes

key_concepts: Skin Deform POP applies transform or skeleton skinning using capture attributes such as pCaptPath, pCaptData, and pCapt.
Mode selects whether the operator deforms geometry directly, deforms an attribute, or treats an attribute scope as positions or vectors.
pCaptPath maps capture indices to bone COMP paths, pCaptData stores bind/rest pose matrices, and pCapt stores index/weight pairs for each point or vertex.
Capture weights should sum to 1 for each point or vertex, and -1 indicates no transform for a capture entry.
Skeleton Root Path resolves the bone hierarchy for imported or captured rigs, while Bone Paths and Bone Bind Poses name the detail attributes used for deformation.
Vectors Maintain Length matters when deforming vector attributes such as normals, and output metadata controls the destination attribute type/components.
common_gotchas: Capture weights should sum to 1 per point/vertex; bad capture data produces distorted deformation.
GPU skinning can be constrained by bone count per pass, so complex rigs may need splitting or preprocessing.
Do not delete capture attributes until no later stage needs to inspect or re-deform the geometry.
